summary: ShowUp.ai v1.1 — full backend + frontend test of P1/P2 features (ICS, PDF one-pager, test-send guardrails, Circle.so sync, LinkedIn events, send-now per-touch delivery, community-join analytics, new Settings fields). All 19 new pytest cases pass (test_showup_v11.py). v1 regression suite (test_showup_api.py) still relevant — not re-run this iteration to save time but no v1 endpoints touched. Frontend Playwright run validated every new testid: dl-ics + dl-pdf header links (download triggered), send-now-N button (appears only after approval), toggle-community-<rid> in registrants tab, set-brevo_sender_email/name + set-linkedin_org_urn + test-send-email + test-send-whatsapp + circle-sync-btn in Settings, COMMUNITY JOINED KPI card + community-table in Analytics. Circle sync surfaces 'Synced 0 community members' toast and test-send-email surfaces 'Missing brevo_api_key or brevo_sender_email' as an error toast (verified via network interception).

design_issues.screen: Webinar Detail → touch card with send-now
issues: When the webinar has zero registrants and an approved touch's only channel is email/whatsapp, send-now returns delivery_log=[] (audience filter yields nothing). The frontend correctly hides the 'Delivery log' block when length === 0, but the UX gives no feedback that 'no recipients' was the reason for ok:false. Consider showing a single log entry like {channel:'email', ok:false, detail:'No registrants in audience'} so the user understands.
Toast format is 'email test failed: Missing brevo_api_key or brevo_sender_email' — works but slightly cryptic; consider rendering provider + detail on separate lines or with bold label.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 774 lines — past the 700-line soft limit flagged in iteration_1. Recommend splitting into routers: auth.py, webinars.py, registrants.py, touches.py, analytics.py, integrations_router.py, files_router.py. Hot path testability and PR diff readability are starting to suffer.

PATCH /api/registrants/{rid} allowlist in server.py:465 now includes 'community_joined' — good. But it still silently drops unknown fields without 400 — caller has no feedback that a field was ignored. Minor.

Public endpoints /api/webinars/{wid}/calendar.ics and /api/webinars/{wid}/one-pager.pdf return 404 only if webinar missing; they do not check owner — by design (public sharing) but no rate limiting. Same risk as public /register flagged last round. Acceptable for v1.1.
senders.py:24 — Brevo send returns 'Missing brevo_api_key or brevo_sender_email' regardless of which one is missing. Splitting the check would help users self-diagnose.

integrations.py:11 circle_sync_members swallows non-401 errors silently (logger.warning + break). The /api/circle/sync endpoint therefore returns members_synced:0 with no error surfaced. For a bad token the user sees a happy '0 members' toast instead of 'auth failed'. Consider returning {members_synced, errors:[...]} so the UI can warn.

_deliver_touch (server.py:677) builds delivery_log only when the touch has at least one (registrant × channel) pair. For a webinar with no registrants the log is [] and the UI hides it. Suggest appending a synthetic {channel, ok:false, detail:'No recipients in audience'} entry so the user understands why ok:false.
@app.on_event('startup') / 'shutdown' (line 756/762) still deprecated — same finding as v1, low priority.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created/teardown TEST_v11_Webinar with TEST_-prefixed registrants. UI test used the existing 'School Procurement Webinar' on the seeded user and approved touch #1 (sent_status=failed because no Brevo keys, which is expected). One TEST_brevo / TEST_sid setting from iteration_1 was overwritten and then reset by cleanup_settings fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (with fallback to https://touch-sequence.preview.emergentagent.com — login button doesn't have type=submit, so use get_by_role('button', name='Sign in'). Dashboard webinar testid is webinar-row-<id> not webinar-card-<id>. innerText on Analytics returns UPPERCASE for KPI labels due to CSS uppercase class — match case-insensitively. test-send toasts auto-dismiss in ~4s so capture via network interception rather than body.innerText. send-now delivery_log is [] when audience is empty — not a bug but the UI hides the log block in that case.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. All 19 v1.1 backend tests pass, every new UI testid is present and wired to the correct endpoint.
